errors_cause_blocked_detail_linux: Detail of the blocked request cause on Linux, where stderr.log exists. The commands stay as written.
errors_cause_blocked_detail_macos: Detail of the blocked request cause on macOS: the command that reads the app log.
errors_cause_blocked_detail_other: Detail of the blocked request cause when the operating system is not known.
errors_cause_blocked_detail_windows: Detail of the blocked request cause on Windows: the PowerShell command that reads the app log.
errors_cause_blocked_title: Likely-cause card for a failed fetch, a CSP block or a load failure.
errors_cause_old_host_detail: Detail of the old host cause: what is missing and how to restart (it ends the terminals running in it).
errors_cause_old_host_title: Likely-cause card: the running terminal host (hostd) lacks a capability this app version needs.
errors_cause_shape_detail: Detail of the unexpected data shape cause, when the stack names no app file.
errors_cause_shape_detail_at: Detail of the unexpected data shape cause. {frame} is the first app frame of the stack, such as Editor.svelte:45:6.
errors_cause_shape_title: Likely-cause card for a TypeError such as 'undefined is not an object'.
errors_crash_card_body_crash: Body of the crash card when the earlier session left a crash report file. Says it stayed local.
errors_crash_card_body_hostd_exited: Body of the crash card when the terminal host (hostd) ended on its own in the earlier session. 'Its terminals' are the terminals Atlas had open.
errors_crash_card_dismiss: Button on the card shown after Atlas closed unexpectedly last time: hides the card until the next crash.
errors_crash_card_hint_crash: Hint under the title on the report screen opened from the crash card, for a crash of the earlier session. Says the details are redacted before sending.
errors_crash_card_hint_hostd_exited: Hint under the title on the report screen opened from the crash card, when the terminal host ended on its own. Says the details are redacted before sending.
errors_crash_card_report: Button on the card shown after Atlas closed unexpectedly last time: opens the report screen with the redacted summary of that crash.
errors_crash_card_title_crash: Title of the crash card and of its report screen when the earlier session left a crash report file.
errors_crash_card_title_hostd_exited: Title of the crash card and of its report screen when the terminal host (hostd) ended on its own in the earlier session.
errors_headline_command_hint: Line under the failed command title.
errors_headline_command_title: Title for a failed command the person started. {what} is the command's own name as the code gave it (English, capitalized), shown as is.
errors_headline_command_unnamed_title: Title for a failed command that gave no name.
errors_headline_error_hint: Line under the unexpected error title.
errors_headline_error_title: Title of the error toast for an error thrown outside any view and caught by the window handler.
errors_headline_host_hint: Line under the host failure title: what the diagnostics hold and that secrets are removed.
errors_headline_host_title: Title of the toast and details dialog for a failure of the terminal host (hostd).
errors_headline_rejection_hint: Line under the background task title: what happened, that the app still runs, what to do.
errors_headline_rejection_title: Title of the error toast for an unhandled promise rejection: something the app started on its own.
errors_headline_restart_host_title: Title of the error toast when the Restart terminal host button itself fails.
errors_panel_ai_note: Note at the top of the Ask AI list: each action copies a full prompt, opens an agent with it when a worktree is open, and nothing is sent until the person sends it.
errors_panel_already_reported: Note on the error screen when an open GitHub issue already has this error's fingerprint. {number} is the issue number, {title} its title.
errors_panel_ask_ai: Button of the error card that opens the list of AI actions, and the accessible name of that list.
errors_panel_breadcrumbs: Caption above the list of the last things the app did before the error, in the expanded details of the error card.
errors_panel_close_tab: Button of the error card that replaces a crashed tab: closes that tab. The default label of ErrorPanel's close action.
errors_panel_copied: Replaces the Copy details label for about a second after the details were copied.
errors_panel_copy_details: Button of the error card: copies the plain-text details (version, where, message, stack) to the clipboard.
errors_panel_copy_markdown: Ask AI list row: copies the whole error report as Markdown.
errors_panel_copy_markdown_hint: Hint under the Copy as Markdown row of Ask AI.
errors_panel_detail_file: Row label in the expanded details of the error card: the file the crashed tab was showing.
errors_panel_detail_system: Row label in the expanded details of the error card: the operating system and architecture.
errors_panel_detail_where: Row label in the expanded details of the error card: the part of the app that was rendering when it failed.
errors_panel_details: Toggle that expands the technical details (where, file, versions, recent steps, stack) of the error card; also the Details button of an error toast.
errors_panel_explain: Ask AI action: copies a prompt that asks any chat AI to explain the error in plain language.
errors_panel_explain_hint: Hint under the Explain it to me action of Ask AI.
errors_panel_file_issue: Ask AI action: hands the error to an agent that files a GitHub issue.
errors_panel_file_issue_hint: Hint under the File an issue action of Ask AI. gh is the GitHub CLI, kept as is.
errors_panel_fix_it: Ask AI action: hands the error to a coding agent to fix. The hint under it says how.
errors_panel_fix_it_hint: Hint under the Fix it action of Ask AI: the agent writes a failing test first, then fixes the root cause.
errors_panel_me_too: Button that copies this error's report and opens the existing issue, where the person pastes it as a comment.
errors_panel_me_too_hint: Hint under the button that adds the person's details to an existing issue.
errors_panel_report_anyway: Button that opens the new-issue form although a similar issue exists.
errors_panel_report_issue: Button of the error card: opens the project's GitHub issue form with the report already filled in.
errors_panel_searching: Label of Report issue while Atlas searches GitHub for an issue with the same fingerprint.
errors_route_hint: Line under the title of the full-window error. Names the Ask AI button, which must read the same as errors_panel_ask_ai.
errors_route_no_screen_at: Message line of the not-found screen. {path} is the address that did not match any screen, such as /tray.
errors_route_not_found_hint: Line under the title of the not-found screen.
errors_route_not_found_title: Title of the full-window error for an address no screen answers.
errors_route_reload: Primary button of the full-window error: reloads the app window.
errors_route_title: Title of the full-window error shown when a whole screen of the app fails.
errors_toasts_dialog_title: Title of the dialog that a Details button of an error toast opens.
errors_toasts_host_help: Body of the error toast shown while the terminal host (hostd) cannot be reached: what stops working and what to do.
errors_toasts_restart_host: Button of the error toast about the unreachable terminal host: ends its terminals and starts a new host.
